Description:
Ballistics of 115x728R 3UBM5 round, with the 3BM6 steel core APFSDS-T shot, fired from the U-5TS tank gun (GRAU index 2A20), chiefly employed on the T-62 tank. Introduction date is some point from 1964 to 1966, with the round revised in 1966-1968 to eliminate the armor-piercing cap.

Note: no reliable muzzle velocity exist for this projectile. Values reflect "most probable" according to this author's opinion.

Barrel Length:      5840 mm
Cartridge Length:    723 mm
Projectile Mass:   5.335 kg
Projectile Travel:  5117 mm
Peak Pressure:      3650 kgf/cm^2 (copper crusher gauge)
Chambrage:          1.37
Propellant:        7.934 kg, 4.734 kg 12/7 + 3.2 kg 18/1


References:
- 115-мм ТАНКОВАЯ ПУШКА У-5ТС (2A20) ТЕХНИЧЕСКОЕ ОПИСАНИЕ И ИНСТРУКЦИЯ ПО ЭКСПЛУАТАЦИИ, издательство «МАШИНОСТРОЕНИЕ», Москва, 1970
- 《苏T-62中型坦克资料汇编》国营内蒙第一机械制造厂技术改造办公室 (1967.6) wrt. shell construction & details.
